A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 25-page versions of the same POYO-CAP paper, including Appendices A–N. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support reliable comparison of the text, equations, figures, and tables.

before.justification: v2 reports original movie-reconstruction and drifting-gratings classification experiments in Section 4 and Table 3, alongside original data analyses, simulations, and ablations in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains the original decoding experiments in Section 4 and Table 3 and the original analyses, simulations, and ablations in the appendices.

M1.justification: The neuron-selection procedure, masked reconstruction with auxiliary classification, encoder, task-specific decoders, and training losses are unchanged in Section 3 and the appendices.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Allen Brain Observatory recordings, 13 Cre lines, Natural Movie One reconstruction task, and drifting-gratings classification task. No datasets, populations, or test scenarios change.

E2.justification: Table 3 retains identical comparator membership, including the from-scratch baseline, CEBRA, and architecture, data-selection, and objective variants. Appendix K retains the same Transformer-decoder comparison.

E3.justification: The evaluation settings are identical, including the movie 80/10/10 and drifting-gratings 70/10/20 splits in Appendix A, pretraining–finetuning separation, sample counts, metrics, and capacity-matching controls.

E4.justification: The same architecture, data-selection, and objective ablations, loss-landscape and representation analyses, curriculum simulations, weight-dynamics analysis, and encoder-freezing study appear in both versions.

E5.justification: Both retain Table 3's three-seed reporting with 95% confidence intervals and paired t-tests, along with the 10,000-sample bootstrap regression analysis in Section 4.3. No uncertainty-reporting practices change.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results match, including every appendix result. Table 3 retains POYO-CAP's movie SSIM of 0.593±0.013 and drifting-gratings accuracy of 0.555±0.022, with identical comparator values.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, equations, algorithms, and theoretical reasoning are unchanged, including Equations 1–7, Algorithms S1–S2, and the theoretical discussions in Appendices D–G.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about predictability-guided pretraining, improved decoding and data efficiency, and stable model scaling.

C2.justification: Mechanistic interpretations and applicability qualifications are unchanged, including the shared stimulus-set evaluation, within-animal downstream splits, controlled mouse visual-cortex setting, and qualification that statistical proxies do not establish biological causality.

D1.justification: Hardware, initialization, hyperparameters, processing instructions, decoder details, and access information are unchanged. The added funding acknowledgement supplies no new technical or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and complete reference list are identical after matching entries across page breaks. Garipov et al. and Paul et al. move to subsequent pages; neither is newly cited.

P1.justification: v3 adds a funding acknowledgement for NSF and DoD OUSD (R&E) under Cooperative Agreement DBI-2229929 and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The added acknowledgement expands the acknowledgements area and shifts bibliography placement and page breaks across pages 11–13. All figures, tables, equations, and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 adds funding attribution and reflows the bibliography, while the scientific text, evidence, technical documentation, limitations, and displays remain unchanged throughout the main paper and appendices. The attribution addition does not produce a meaningful overall quality difference.
